evidence.title: Claude Design. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Claude Design
summary: Newsletter guide to Claude Design: access, quick tests, a video hack for better slides and a Cowork workflow.
description: Guide from Ruben Hassid's How to AI newsletter (22 April 2026) to Claude Design, the separate design product at claude.ai/design that runs on Opus 4.7. It covers who can access it (Pro or Max; a Team/Enterprise admin toggle), three sub-2-minute tests — one-shot website, slide deck, animated video — the trick of turning a research report into an animated video first because the slides come out better, copy-any-design tips, and an advanced Cowork + Claude Design workflow where brand assets become a DESIGN.md that every later prompt reuses.
contains: needs a paid Claude plan (Pro or Max); Team/Enterprise admins must enable it
3 quick tests: website, slide deck, animated video
video hack: turn a report into animated video, then a better slide deck
advanced workflow: Cowork extracts brand assets into a DESIGN.md
drop the DESIGN.md into Claude Design as context for every later prompt
